items.title: TIDAL Will Label AI-Generated Music, Block It From Earning Royalties
items.excerpt: TIDAL will begin labeling tracks it determines are entirely AI-generated and will block them from earning royalties, prioritizing payouts for music 'directly produced, written, and performed by people' — a policy that directly affects how AI-music creators distribute and get paid.

items.title: IK Multimedia introduce ReSing Voices Brazilian Pack
items.excerpt: IK Multimedia expands its ReSing AI vocal-synthesis platform with eight new Brazilian Portuguese voice models, letting producers turn a scratch vocal into a professional-sounding performance in a new language — a fresh AI-vocals craft tool, launched alongside a Singer Showcase discovery platform.

items.title: Can Meaw Chain make 'vibe mixing' a thing?
items.excerpt: Meaw Chain is an AI-powered plugin that analyses your audio and assembles a suitable chain of effects from a natural-language text prompt — pitching 'vibe mixing' as a way to build processing chains by describing the sound you want rather than dialling in each plugin by hand.

items.title: Fender Studio Pro 8.1 DAW review
items.excerpt: Fender's Studio Pro 8.1 DAW folds in a suite of AI features — a beta Studio Assistant chatbot, Moises-powered stem separation and generation, voice replacement and Vocal Tune pitch correction — with the review calling the Moises stem quality among the best it has heard.

items.title: BandLab Technologies acquires AI-powered music-making platform Aiode
items.excerpt: BandLab Technologies has acquired Aiode, an AI music studio that lets creators produce tracks using fully-licensed audio from professional musicians and producers — folding a rights-cleared generative music tool into BandLab's creator platform and signalling where its AI making tools head next.
